newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent trading hours over Christmas/New Year.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent trading hours over Christmas/New Year.

text.p: The Brent market on the Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) will be closed on Wednesday and Thursday in line with U.K. holidays, SIMEX officials said on Monday.
SIMEX will close at the earlier-than-normal time of 1600 hours (0800 GMT) on Tuesday December 24 and Tuesday December 31.
The following is the SIMEX Brent and SIMEX fuel oil schedule for the Christmas and New Year holiday period. Normal trading hours will apply outside the dates specified.
The table is in local time with Greenwich Mean Time in brackets.
